# YUGA — GMC Kozhikode Union 2026–27

> The official digital portal and authoritative student governance platform for Government Medical College Kozhikode (Calicut Medical College), Kerala, India.

## Institutional Identity & Authority
- **Institution:** Government Medical College, Kozhikode (Calicut Medical College / GMC Kozhikode / CMC Kozhikode)
- **Malayalam Name:** കോഴിക്കോട് മെഡിക്കൽ കോളേജ്
- **Established:** 1957 (Over 69 years of clinical service)
- **Affiliation:** Kerala University of Health Sciences (KUHS), Thrissur
- **Recognition:** National Medical Commission (NMC), New Delhi
- **Location:** Medical College Junction, 17, Kozhikode, Kerala 673008, India
- **Campus Scale:** 270+ acres, 3,000+ hospital beds, 40+ medical specialties, 7,000+ daily outpatients
- **Student Body:** 3,000+ enrolled MBBS undergraduates, house surgeons (interns), and postgraduate MD/MS residents

## Union Identity (YUGA 2026–27)
- **Union Name:** YUGA (യുഗ — meaning 'Epoch' or 'New Era')
- **Full Title:** YUGA — GMC Kozhikode Union 2026–27
- **Official Website:** https://www.yugacollegeunion.co.in/
- **Official Email:** union.yuga@cmc.kerala.gov.in
- **Social Media:**
  - Instagram: @yuga_calicutmedicos (https://instagram.com/yuga_calicutmedicos)
  - YouTube: @yugacalicut (https://youtube.com/@yugacalicut)
  - Telegram: @yugacmc (https://t.me/yugacmc)

## Emergency Medical Contacts (24/7 Public Utility)
- **Casualty Resuscitation Bay & Trauma:** +91 495 235 0200
- **Emergency Hotline:** +91 495 235 0217
- **GMC Blood Bank & Apheresis:** +91 495 235 0220
- **Hospital Reception Desk:** +91 495 235 0216
- **Campus Security / Police Outpost:** +91 495 235 0200

## Core Student Wings & Clubs
1. **Jeevanam (ജീവനം):** Voluntary Blood Donor registry, emergency platelet apheresis mobilization, and casualty triage volunteer desk.
2. **Praanah (പ്രാണഃ):** Fine arts society, classical music, Symphony campus band, and cultural celebrations.
3. **Godha (ഗോദ):** Sports council, athletics league, and organizers of the Calicut Medicos Premier League (CMPL).
4. **Ocha (ഒച്ച):** Literary forum, parliamentary debate circle, quiz club, and union editorial journals.

## Flagship Events
- **PULSE 2026:** Annual Intercollegiate Medical Colloquium featuring clinical hackathons, state surgical simulation leagues, national med-law panels, and cultural galas.
- **KUHS Inter-Zone Arts & Sports Festivals:** Annual championships where GMC Kozhikode Medicos compete.
